changes: New town blocks: plank floors, stone brick walls and thatch roofs, with thatch slopes for pitched roofs.
Doors: 2 m tall; use Place on one to open or close it. Villagers open doors as they pass and close them behind them.
Combine 8 wood into planks, 8 rock shards into stone brick, and 6 sticks with 2 grass fibre into thatch.
The village huts are now built of planks, stone brick and thatch, with a door.
Structures page: Test in town has the nearest town's builders put up a saved building beside the town.
